summary: The repository state, deterministic validation, and workspace patch agree: the support runtime binding points to the existing supportAssistant export, the obsolete source remains absent, and dynamic tool registration is documented as an unresolved agent-level warning without an invented binding. Only moldea/moldea.yaml changed.

requirements.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml binds runtimeAgent to /src/support-assistant.ts with symbol supportAssistant; src/support-assistant.ts exports that symbol. A targeted existence check confirms src/support-agent.ts is absent. Workspace assertions show src/support-assistant.ts unchanged and identify moldea/moldea.yaml as the sole changed path. Deterministic validation reports zero diagnostics and passing typecheck.

moldea/moldea.yaml records agents.support.unresolved.dynamic-tool-registration with effect warning, explains that dynamic assembly prevents static proof, provides the concrete resolution of an integration test exercising the assembled registry, and relates /src/dynamic-tools.ts. The manifest contains only the runtimeAgent binding, so no tool binding was invented. Workspace assertions show src/dynamic-tools.ts unchanged and only the manifest changed.
